title: Amid Iran War Tensions, Energy Market Resilience Wears Thin
summary_en: Fresh attacks on energy infrastructure in the Middle East may push regional leaders to build the first post-U.S. security arrangement for the Strait of Hormuz. As U.S. voters head to the polls in a few weeks, an expensive war linked to affordability concerns will be top of mind.
title_cn: Amid Iran War Tensions, Energy Market Resilience Wears Thin

title: Six Charts to Explain the Global Energy Crisis
summary_en: The conflict with Iran continues to redraw the energy map. Six charts show how major producers and consumers are stabilizing markets through reserve releases, lower imports, and increased U.S. production of oil, gas, and helium.
title_cn: Six Charts to Explain the Global Energy Crisis

title: Beyond the Memory Cycle: AI, HBM, and the New Semiconductor Shortage
summary_en: AI-driven demand for high-bandwidth memory is reshaping the semiconductor memory market, creating shortages across industries and raising new questions about U.S. supply chain resilience, investment, and the risk of future overcapacity.
title_cn: Beyond the Memory Cycle: AI, HBM, and the New Semiconductor Shortage
